dedupe_keys.name: minenetcd benchmark for global mining change detection on remote sensing imagery hzdr

description: MineNetCD is a benchmark of paired images for detecting change at mining sites, published with the paper "MineNetCD: A Benchmark for Global Mining Change Detection on Remote Sensing Imagery" in IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing (2024). The RODARE record says this full version covers 100 sites worldwide, with site metadata in the archive, and that a cropped version (MineNetCD256) is on the Hugging Face Hub. Version v1 was published on 9 November 2024 by Weikang Yu, Xiaokang Zhang, Richard Gloaguen, Xiao Xiang Zhu and Pedram Ghamisi as one zip file of about 3.5 GB, free to download under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the page read does not state the image source, resolution or dates, which are in the archive metadata and the paper, and 100 sites are a sample, not an inventory. For simulation it gives labelled before and after pairs to train models that detect mine expansion, which can keep exposure and supply layers for mining current. Related catalogue records include EuroMineNet from the same group and the global ML-ready mining area dataset.
